name: SourcePRD
description:
SourcePRD reads your codebase and writes the product story: the doors people come in through, the areas inside, and every capability — what it is, how people use it, and the files that implement it. Not the plan; the product as it exists in the code today.

Connect it and Claude can answer from that story: what the product does, how a capability works for the person using it, which files stand behind it, and what changed this day, week or month — the story is re-checked against the code on a schedule and updated only where the code moved.

Tools (all read-only): list your projects; the product overview; the full story; doors, areas and capabilities; one capability in depth with its implementing files; search; and what changed since a day, week, month or date.

Sign in with your SourcePRD account and allow read access; every project you can open is available. Nothing is written back to your code or your account. Every SourcePRD account can read the public demo projects, so you can try it before connecting your own repository.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SourcePRD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SourcePRD to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pm.sourceprd.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SourcePRD MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SourcePRD provides these MCP tools: get_feature, get_prd, get_project, list_features, list_projects, search_prd, and what_changed.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SourcePRD?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SourcePRD in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SourcePRD requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SourcePRD is developed by SOFTLINK LTD. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
